# Data

```{r}
#| label: data-size
c(rows = nrow(cigar), states = nlevels(cigar$state), missing = sum(is.na(cigar)))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data
#| tbl-cap: "First six rows of the preprocessed data."
cigar |>
  select(state, year_full, sales, rprice, rpimin, rincome) |>
  head() |>
  kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("State", "Year", "Sales", "Real price",
                                  "Real neighbour min. price", "Real income"))
```

# Figures

```{r}
#| label: fig-intro
#| fig-cap: "Log sales against log real price. Left: one pooled line. Right: one line per state."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
p_pooled <- ggplot(cigar, aes(log_rprice, log_sales)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = year_full), alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", se = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Year") +
  labs(title = "Pooled", x = "log real price", y = "log packs per person")
p_state <- ggplot(cigar, aes(log_rprice, log_sales, group = state)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "By state", x = "log real price", y = NULL)
(p_pooled | p_state) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-trends
#| fig-cap: "Real price and sales per person over time. Grey: states, black: median."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
trend <- cigar |>
  select(state, year_full, rprice, sales) |>
  pivot_longer(c(rprice, sales), names_to = "var", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(var = recode(var, rprice = "Real price (1983 cents)", sales = "Packs per person"))
trend_median <- trend |>
  group_by(var, year_full) |>
  summarise(value = median(value), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(trend, aes(year_full, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = state), colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = trend_median, linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ var, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-outcome
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of sales per person on the original and log scale."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
(ggplot(cigar, aes(sales)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40) + labs(x = "Packs per person", y = "Count")) |
  (ggplot(cigar, aes(log_sales)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40) + labs(x = "log packs per person", y = NULL))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-covariates
#| fig-cap: "Log sales against the control variables with a LOESS smoother."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4
cigar |>
  select(log_sales, log_rpimin, log_rincome, year_full) |>
  pivot_longer(-log_sales, names_to = "covariate", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(covariate = recode(covariate,
                            log_rpimin = "log real neighbour min. price",
                            log_rincome = "log real income",
                            year_full = "Year")) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, log_sales)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, colour = "firebrick", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ covariate, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log packs per person")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-state-slopes
#| fig-cap: "Exploratory least-squares price slopes per state (±2 SE), with a linear year trend. Dashed: pooled slope."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8
state_slopes <- cigar |>
  group_by(state) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    co <- summary(lm(log_sales ~ log_rprice + year_c, data = .x))$coefficients["log_rprice", ]
    tibble(est = co[["Estimate"]], se = co[["Std. Error"]])
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(state = reorder(state, est))
pooled_slope <- coef(lm(log_sales ~ log_rprice + year_c, data = cigar))[["log_rprice"]]
ggplot(state_slopes, aes(est, state)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pooled_slope, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = est - 2 * se, xmax = est + 2 * se), size = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Price slope", y = "State") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
